sources.title: Blackfrost-AI/Qwen3.8-27B-ABLITERATED-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: All nine main GGUF quants were rebuilt with Qwen3.8's native MTP head embedded directly in each model. This removes the separate-draft loading failure reported with the earlier sidecars and improves one-file llama.cpp compatibility.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is a refusal-ablated build of Qwen3.8-27B, released by huihui-ai, 27B parameters, available in GGUF, Transformers and NVFP4.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a abliterated and uncensored variant of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, published on Hugging Face by shawnw3i. It is 27B parameters, 48GB VRAM class class and apache-2.0 licence. It is distributed across 4 repositories in GGUF, AWQ and GPTQ formats, totalling 91.3K downloads. sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.
